description: This Java class 'AarResourceClassRegistry' manages resource class lookup for AAR libraries in Android development. It handles adding libraries, retrieving package info from manifests, and finding class definitions.

classes.name: AarResourceClassRegistry
classes.description: Manages resource class lookup for AAR libraries, including adding libraries and retrieving class definitions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the registry.

methods.name: addLibrary
methods.description: Adds an AAR library to the registry, creating a generator for it if applicable.

methods.name: getAarPackage
methods.description: Retrieves the package name from the AAR's AndroidManifest.xml.

methods.name: findClassDefinition
methods.description: Finds the class definition byte array for a given resource class name.
